post.description: Current active verified account session, environment access, secrets:write, caller key grant and applicable approval/step-up required. Mandatory expected_generation, membership_version and snapshot_token fence the current transaction snapshot; stale state returns 409. Payload must contain every live secret exactly once with id/version and nonempty ciphertext fields, including path_enc; empty environments may rotate. All eligible current holders need wraps except explicit remove_user, and caller must remain. Runner wrap is allowed and required only with explicit runner replacement-wrap policy. Atomic commit replaces old-key history, removes tombstones, advances generation, clears pending, invalidates runner jobs and appends audit. No plaintext or client private key reaches the server.
